method: Served bundle (3-seed e3_rainstab, calibrated) via inference_adapter.Inference; window ending 2021-07-15 (doy 196) from the kit NetCDF; shock = kit warm_ocean (+3 K t2m, +15% of last-day tcwv, box lat 8-20, lon 82-94); farm region 18.5-25.5N, 74.5-83.5E, land_sea_mask >= 0.5 (80 cells), forecast days 1-7; dashboard formulas (cos-lat weighted regional mean, dry < 2.5 mm/day, heavy >= 10 mm/day).
